answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in harbor and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the ridge graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 692 impostors cost 1563 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
